jobs.label: CAM_frame1_generator_panel
jobs.prompt: Amateur documentation photo taken in 2009 with a cheap silver compact digital camera with built-in flash fired straight on: a grey industrial electrical generator control panel on a painted concrete wall in the technical room of an underground facility, metal cabinet with a few gauges and toggle switches, cable trays, a caged ceiling light at the top edge. Harsh direct flash, bright centre and dark falloff to the corners, slight overexposed highlights on the metal, mild digital noise, 4:3 frame, slightly tilted. No people, no readable text, no logos, no brand names, no date stamp.
